title: Infoveave expands Unified Decision Intelligence Platform with Agentic AI Assistant 'Fovea'
description: Bengaluru (Karnataka) [India], July 30: Enterprises today generate more data than ever before; yet this has not enabled organisations to make timely, effective business decisions. While organisations have invested heavily in AI, analytics and dashboards, most still struggle with fragmented information, inconsistent data quality and AI systems that lack business context.

title: BrowserStack Launches Test Companion, Agentic AI That Brings Complete Test Automation Into the IDE
description: Dublin [Ireland], July 30: BrowserStack, the leading AI-native software testing platform, today announced Test Companion, agentic AI for test automation built into the IDE. Built for QA teams and automation engineers, it accelerates test authoring, execution, debugging, and maintenance across web and mobile applications.
